change.summary: The int32 field bountyLevel was removed from every object in info.participants[] (ParticipantDto). The key is absent, not null, so strictly-typed clients failed to deserialize any newly played match. Riot also dropped the field from its own published DTO reference at the same time.

spec.note: Riot publishes reference docs rather than an OpenAPI description, and the DTO reference was edited to match the new behaviour rather than announcing the change.

changelog.note: developer.riotgames.com/changelog returns 404 — there is no changelog to watch. Riot does announce when it chooses to (the summonerId deprecation two months later went out on X), so this was a decision not to.

contract.note: Fetch one recent match and diff the participant object's key set against a stored baseline. Needs nothing beyond an ordinary API key.

notes: The strongest silent-change evidence in the dataset: Riot's own public bug tracker carries an issue reporting this exact undocumented removal, still open and uncommented sixteen months later. A community schema repository had to re-add the field by hand because Riot had deleted it from the published DTO too.
